entities.name: Mornsong
entities.description: A tribe of Lorwyn elves of the Arbor Morning, honoring singing and wearing purple and silver.

entities.name: Gilt-Leaf
entities.description: Elven tribe with unquestioned rule over Lorwyn.

entities.name: Peradala
entities.description: A Mornsong perfect and greatest singer of Lorwyn, betrothed to Eidren.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Queen of the fae whose agenda led to the massacre; created a duplicate of Maralen.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: Peradala's handmaiden; the survivor was a duplicate created by Oona who overthrows her creator.

events.summary: The Mornsong plan to assimilate into the Gilt-Leaf through a strategic marriage of their ruling perfects.
events.quote: through a strategic marriage of their ruling perfects

events.summary: Enchanted vines and faeries slaughter Peradala's wedding convoy as Oona furthers her agenda.
events.quote: enchanted vines and faeries slaughtered her wedding convoy as Oona furthered her agenda

events.summary: Maralen, apparently surviving, is in fact a duplicate created by Oona and will overthrow her creator to become queen of the fae.
events.quote: was in fact a duplicate created by Oona

relations.quote: a perfect of Mornsong, was the greatest singer of Lorwyn
